name: sugi
description: Anonymous image and short-video host on Cloudflare Workers, R2 and D1

IP_HASH_SECRET.description: Random secret (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`). Uploads are fingerprinted with an HMAC of the uploader IP under this key instead of storing the IP; uploads are refused until it is set.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Random token (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) for the admin endpoints: deleting any file and purging everything uploaded from one source.

DB.description: D1 database for albums. The Worker creates its tables on the first request.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket that stores the uploaded files.
